items.stem: Combining two assets with low correlation into a portfolio generally:

options.text: Reduces overall portfolio volatility for a given return
options.rationale: Correct: low correlation is the source of the diversification benefit.

options.text: Increases volatility because there are more assets
options.rationale: More low-correlation assets tend to lower, not raise, volatility.
Correlation is precisely what drives the diversification effect.
Diversification manages risk, it does not guarantee return.

items.stem: A portfolio has drifted so one stock is now 30% of its value. The most appropriate disciplined action is usually to:

options.text: Rebalance back toward the target weights
options.rationale: Correct: rebalancing restores the intended risk profile.

options.text: Buy more of the same stock to ride the momentum

options.rationale: A full liquidation is an overreaction and costly.
Ignoring large drift lets risk exceed the plan.
